title: Keyset Pagination vs. OFFSET Pagination
realWorldScenario: A mobile app user scrolls through infinite search results: `SELECT * FROM orders ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 500000;`. The API response time degrades from 15ms on page 1 to 4.2 seconds on page 25,000.
questionStatement: Why does OFFSET pagination degrade linearly with high offsets? How does Keyset Pagination (Cursor Pagination) solve this with O(1) performance?
expectedConcepts: Consistent response time regardless of page depth
hints: Use the last seen date and ID in a WHERE clause instead of OFFSET.
